info.title: Gameyfin public API
info.description: Stable REST-API for integration with 3rd party applications and services. Requires a personal access tokens or API key to use.

tags.name: Games
tags.description: Browse, update and delete games in the catalog.

tags.name: Instance
tags.description: Instance information, health and background task runs.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: Platforms and metadata options supported by the instance.

tags.name: Downloads
tags.description: Download providers, game downloads and game images.

tags.name: Collections
tags.description: Manage game collections and their members.

tags.name: Libraries
tags.description: Manage libraries, their configuration and scans.

tags.name: Requests
tags.description: Game requests, their status and votes.

GameMediaV1.description: JSON metadata describing the complete cover, header and gallery. Image entries reference an existing image id, a URL, or an uploaded file via uploadKey.

GamePatchV1.description: JSON Merge Patch: omitted fields stay unchanged, null clears summary, comment or release; arrays replace their contents. Other null values are rejected.

UserV1.description: Public user profile. Email, account status, SSO status and roles are included only for administrator personal tokens.
